contract.definition: u: User = User.allInstances()->any(x: User | x.UserID = uid), c: BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstances()->any(y: BookCopy | y.Barcode = barcode)
contract.precondition: User.allInstances()->one(x: User | x.UserID = uid) and BookCopy.allInstances()->one(y: BookCopy | y.Barcode = barcode and y.Status = CopyStatus::LOANED and y.IsReserved = false)
contract.postcondition: let r: Reserve in r.oclIsNew() and Reserve.allInstances()->includes(r) and r.ReserveDate = Today and r.IsReserveClosed = false and r.ReservedUser = u and r.ReservedCopy = c and c.IsReserved = true and u.ReservedBook->includes(r) and c.ReservationRecord->includes(r) and result = true
